events.text: It is the final watch. My doctrine is to charge in the last watch and take the middle crossing (F2). Rhino units are positioned to support this. I see enemy presence at F1 and F2 from both Orchid and Tiger. I must exploit the chaos and secure F2, or capture a camp standard.

HORSE, ATTACK AT NORTH BANK MIDDLE.

events.text: Last watch. Doctrine: Last-watch charge. Kite holds F3 (East Ford) with all forces. Need to secure F1 or F2 or take a camp. Since I hold F3, I must hold one more ford or take a camp. I will charge the nearest enemy position, assuming they are near a ford or camp.

events.text: Tiger has offered a truce, which is in effect. I must consolidate my position and hold my fords as per doctrine. My units are relatively positioned, but I need to ensure no enemy is close enough to challenge my holds. Since a truce is active, aggressive action is not required.
